notes.title: Small Update – Steam Integration Patch!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Quick update from the soap squad:

We just rolled out a small but mighty patch with some cool Steam features added based on your feedback:

✅ What’s New:
- Steam Achievements are live! Can you unlock Bar of Justice or Soap to the Top?
- Steam Cloud Save support is now active – continue your escape across any device.
- Steam Leaderboards added! Compete for fastest runs and show who’s the slipperiest bar in prison.
- Minor bug fixes and visual polish.

Thanks for playing Don’t Drop the Soap! If you’ve enjoyed the chaos, consider leaving a review—it helps more than you think 💙

Stay soapy,
— The Soap Team 🫧
